# B"H

## Boruch Hashem — Blessed is He

From hidden source to visible screen, the Awtsmoos renews the in-between;
Each module small, each boundary clear, makes Awtsmoos.com calm, alive, and keen.

# Final Execution Plan

1. Discover exact files for social feed, hub, profile, aliases, heichel/heichelos, reader/series, comments, notifications, composers, and editors.
2. Read batches of entry HTML, imported CSS, JS controllers, API adapters, and shared dependencies.
3. Build an affected-routes/import graph and identify conflict-prone styles and oversized modules.
4. Rewrite whole touched files only; split real responsibilities into submodules instead of partial patches.
5. Introduce feature-scoped CSS capsules with local tokens and imported submodules; no unscoped global selectors.
6. Refactor JavaScript into documented, data-oriented classes and focused helpers while preserving external contracts.
7. Finish coding for a coherent vertical slice before tests.
8. Run syntax/lint/build/tests available in the repository.
9. Launch/attach browser runtime and inspect social routes across responsive widths.
10. Fix console errors, clipping, overlaps, z-index issues, focus issues, loading/empty/error states, and broken API behavior.
11. Re-read all touched files, run indentation/line-size audits, and compare planned versus actual.
12. Update remaining-work and handoff evidence; continue into the next uncovered surface.
